title: Freed ID deferred credential transaction, notification, replay, and expiry state-machine profile
hypothesis: A synthetic state machine can reject malformed or replayed deferred-issuance and notification transitions while preserving the final OpenID4VCI protocol boundaries and reserving real cryptography and interoperability.
rollback: Return to the last valid synthetic state, retain rejected transitions, expose no real credentials, and require standards-conformant keys, live interoperability, privacy and security review, and trust governance for production.
boundary: Software and synthetic fixtures can establish only bounded structural behavior. They do not establish empirical GMUT confirmation, THOS effectiveness, production identity assurance, legal or cultural authority, independent reproduction, AGI/ASI, complete accessibility, exhaustive security, or Stage 20 readiness.
